records.name: Acrobatics
records.description: Stay on your feet in a tricky situation, or perform an acrobatic stunt.

records.name: Animal Handling
records.description: Calm or train an animal, or get an animal to behave in a certain way.

records.name: Arcana
records.description: Recall lore about spells, magic items, and the planes of existence.

records.name: Athletics
records.description: Jump farther than normal, stay afloat in rough water, or break something.

records.name: Deception
records.description: Tell a convincing lie, or wear a disguise convincingly.

records.name: History
records.description: Recall lore about historical events, people, nations, and cultures.

records.name: Insight
records.description: Discern a person’s mood and intentions.

records.name: Intimidation
records.description: Awe or threaten someone into doing what you want.

records.name: Investigation
records.description: Find obscure information in books, or deduce how something works.

records.name: Medicine
records.description: Diagnose an illness, or determine what killed the recently slain.

records.name: Nature
records.description: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, and weather.

records.name: Perception
records.description: Using a combination of senses, notice something that’s easy to miss.

records.name: Performance
records.description: Act, tell a story, perform music, or dance.

records.name: Persuasion
records.description: Honestly and graciously convince someone of something.

records.name: Religion
records.description: Recall lore about gods, religious rituals, and holy symbols.

records.name: Sleight of Hand
records.description: Pick a pocket, conceal a handheld object, or perform legerdemain.

records.name: Stealth
records.description: Escape notice by moving quietly and hiding behind things.

records.name: Survival
records.description: Follow tracks, forage, find a trail, or avoid natural hazards.
